scenicChapters.title: Luxembourg Mullerthal Route
scenicChapters.narrative: For 54 km this is Luxembourg Mullerthal Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Luxembourg Mullerthal Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 38 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

places-church-of-our-lady-la-place-forte.story: 185 km from Trier to Trier, about 3 h 11 of riding. It goes by way of City of Luxembourg: its Old Quarters and F, La place forte de Longwy and back through City of Luxembourg: its Old Quarters and F. It crosses Germany, Luxembourg and France - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules.
